Download the zip below, open it, and move **Power Gauge** to Applications.

- **Intel Macs only,** on macOS 11 or later. Apple Silicon isn't supported.
- **The first time you open it, macOS blocks it,** since it isn't notarised. Choose
  **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway**.
- **Start Monitoring asks for an administrator password,** since powermetrics needs root.
